slides.title: FATCA: What it means for you

points.title: What FATCA is
points.text: An agreement between India and your country to share tax resident information transparently.

points.title: Why you fill forms
points.text: You declare tax residency once so both governments know you're investing transparently from abroad.

points.title: Your part
points.text: Tell the truth about where you live and pay taxes. Then invest normally.
